title: 膝盖留出空间
description: 成人低墙在舒适范围抬膝到大脚点，躯干不挤压。

art_direction.medium: soft pastel drawing with clear contour accents
art_direction.scene: A fictional adult lifts one knee only a modest amount to place a climbing shoe on a large nearby foothold, while the opposite foot remains supported low and both hands use generous jugs. The knee opens slightly to a comfortable natural angle, leaving space for the torso rather than forcing a high step. The frame shows the entire low wall section, clear padded landing, and an easy large descent step. Use soft chalk-pastel illustration with tactile color masses, gently smudged architecture, and lavender, muted orange, and deep blue accents. Create one original 1536x1024 wordless scene, fictional fully clothed adults, natural anatomy; no brands, arrows or panels. Climbing stays low above continuous thick mats, with immediate step-down.
